usageNotes: Permanently removes a metrics server (InfluxDB or Graphite) from the cluster configuration by its config ID. Requires `Sys.Modify` at the root (`/`) path — API tokens must carry this privilege explicitly. The operation returns null synchronously; there is no UPID, but the change propagates cluster-wide on the next config sync.

examples.summary: Remove an InfluxDB metrics server named 'influx-prod'

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the named metrics server entry from the cluster config; all nodes stop shipping metrics to that server immediately and the configuration cannot be recovered without re-adding it manually.
tips: Use get_cluster_metrics_server_id to confirm the exact config ID before deleting — IDs follow the pve-configid format (alphanumeric plus hyphens, no spaces).
Deletion takes effect cluster-wide without a restart; verify in the Datacenter → Metric Server UI or via list_cluster_metrics_servers that the entry is gone.
If metrics pipelines (dashboards, alerting) depend on this server, coordinate removal with the monitoring team to avoid silent data gaps.
